items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And I tell you, I think Mr. Bradley called him 'hookey player', see, because he was a cute little man, and he was a great friend, you know. We were good buddies, you see.

ctx.x: Who else would you say you were great friends with, like at the time of the Hoofers Club, or -- was anybody else inspiring you other than John Bubbles?

Yes, there was Roland Holden. He used to -- that was one of Buddy Bradley's students. And I tell you, I think Mr. Bradley called him 'hookey player', see, because he was a cute little man, and he was a great friend, you know. We were good buddies, you see.
How did he inspire you, Roland Holden?
